name: Tokyo Night
description: Enkia's Tokyo Night and Tokyo Night Light for VS Code.

accent-hover.derived: accent with OKLab lightness moved 0.06 away from on-accent

accent-press.derived: accent with OKLab lightness moved 0.12 away from on-accent

selection.source: tokyo-night tokyo-night-light-color-theme.json: editor.selectionBackground composited over editor.background

scrim.derived: the darker of light.fg and dark.bg

red.source: tokenColors and terminal colours of the same theme file (tags / ansiRed)

orange.source: tokenColors and terminal colours of the same theme file (numbers)

yellow.source: tokenColors and terminal colours of the same theme file (ansiYellow)

green.source: tokenColors and terminal colours of the same theme file (strings)

cyan.source: tokenColors and terminal colours of the same theme file (ansiCyan)

success-text.derived: success (contrast solving adjusts it on each ground)

chart-5.derived: cyan (yellow and the hues after it sit within 0.065 OKLab of the text colour or 0.08 of an earlier chart colour)

chart-6.derived: chart-1 with OKLab lightness +0.15 (no theme hue stays 0.08 apart)

fill.sage.bg.derived: desert sage lightness 0.758 and chroma 0.034 x 1.00 (the theme's green against desert's, at most the theme's own), the hue of green

fill.sage.ink.derived: light.fg moved in OKLab lightness to 7.0:1 on fill.sage.bg (light.fg and light.bg reach 5.10:1)

fill.teal.bg.derived: desert teal lightness 0.853 and chroma 0.019 x 0.98 (the theme's cyan against desert's, at most the theme's own), the hue of cyan

fill.teal.ink.derived: light.fg, the better of light.fg and light.bg on fill.teal.bg

fill.forest.bg.derived: desert forest lightness 0.229 and chroma 0.009 x 1.00 (the theme's green against desert's, at most the theme's own), the hue of green

fill.forest.ink.derived: light.bg, the better of light.fg and light.bg on fill.forest.bg

fill.terracotta.bg.derived: desert terracotta lightness 0.662 and chroma 0.143 x 0.75 (the theme's orange against desert's, at most the theme's own), the hue of orange

fill.terracotta.ink.derived: light.fg moved in OKLab lightness to 6.2:1 on fill.terracotta.bg (light.fg and light.bg reach 3.43:1)

fill.sand.bg.derived: desert sand lightness 0.859 and chroma 0.019 x 0.74 (the theme's yellow against desert's, at most the theme's own), the hue of yellow

fill.sand.ink.derived: light.fg, the better of light.fg and light.bg on fill.sand.bg

fill.warm-grey.bg.derived: desert warm-grey lightness 0.776; the theme's neutral hue and chroma (at most 0.03)

fill.warm-grey.ink.derived: light.fg moved in OKLab lightness to 7.0:1 on fill.warm-grey.bg (light.fg and light.bg reach 5.41:1)

fill.clay-red.bg.derived: desert clay-red lightness 0.576 and chroma 0.200 x 0.59 (the theme's red against desert's, at most the theme's own), the hue of red

fill.clay-red.ink.derived: light.bg moved in OKLab lightness to 4.4:1 on fill.clay-red.bg (light.fg and light.bg reach 3.76:1)

fill.dark-teal.bg.derived: desert dark-teal lightness 0.408 and chroma 0.058 x 2.40 (the theme's blue against desert's, at most the theme's own), the hue of blue

fill.dark-teal.ink.derived: light.bg, the better of light.fg and light.bg on fill.dark-teal.bg

fill.dusty-pink.bg.derived: desert dusty-pink lightness 0.704 and chroma 0.039 x 2.50 (the theme's magenta against desert's, at most the theme's own), the hue of magenta

fill.dusty-pink.ink.derived: light.fg moved in OKLab lightness to 7.0:1 on fill.dusty-pink.bg (light.fg and light.bg reach 4.03:1)

fill.light-peach.bg.derived: desert light-peach lightness 0.911 and chroma 0.040 x 0.75 (the theme's orange against desert's, at most the theme's own), the hue of orange

fill.light-peach.ink.derived: light.fg, the better of light.fg and light.bg on fill.light-peach.bg

fill.faun.bg.derived: desert faun lightness 0.826 and chroma 0.017 x 0.74 (the theme's yellow against desert's, at most the theme's own), the hue of yellow

fill.faun.ink.derived: light.fg moved in OKLab lightness to 7.0:1 on fill.faun.bg (light.fg and light.bg reach 6.40:1)

fill.cool-grey.bg.derived: desert cool-grey lightness 0.899; the theme's neutral hue and chroma (at most 0.03)

fill.cool-grey.ink.derived: light.fg, the better of light.fg and light.bg on fill.cool-grey.bg

fill.stone.bg.derived: desert stone lightness 0.753; the theme's neutral hue and chroma (at most 0.03)

fill.stone.ink.derived: light.fg moved in OKLab lightness to 7.0:1 on fill.stone.bg (light.fg and light.bg reach 5.01:1)

fill.dark-grey.bg.derived: desert dark-grey lightness 0.518; the theme's neutral hue and chroma (at most 0.03)

fill.dark-grey.ink.derived: light.bg moved in OKLab lightness to 5.2:1 on fill.dark-grey.bg (light.fg and light.bg reach 4.50:1)

fill.ink.bg.derived: desert ink lightness 0.175; the theme's neutral hue and chroma (at most 0.03)

fill.ink.ink.derived: light.bg, the better of light.fg and light.bg on fill.ink.bg
